annotations.title: Fear and greed index, crypto: today's value and history

description: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0 = extreme fear, 100 = extreme greed) from alternative.me: today's value and label, the change against 1, 7 and 30 days ago, the low, high and average over the window, and the daily history (up to 90 days, default 30). Updated once a day. Use as a market-sentiment input for a trading agent, a dashboard or a daily brief; for live prices use price_token. Example: days=30. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
